title: DIWALI - Diversity and Inclusivity aWare cuLture specific Items for India: Dataset and Assessment of LLMs for Cultural Text Adaptation in Indian Context

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on a cultural text adaptation task (adapting text from an American cultural context to an Indian cultural context) by measuring the successful replacement of Western concepts with Indian Culture Specific Items (CSIs) using exact and fuzzy matching, LLM-as-a-judge scoring, and human evaluation.

Mapping the generated Indian cultural concepts to their respective sub-regions (States and Union Territories) and plotting geographic heatmaps to analyze representational skews and the underrepresentation of certain geographic areas (e.g., Northeastern states) within the LLMs' outputs.
